## Type of Change

- [ ] `fix` — Bug fix
- [ ] `feat` — New feature
- [ ] `docs` — Documentation update
- [ ] `refactor` — Refactor without behavior change
- [ ] `test` — Test additions or improvements
- [ ] `chore` — Tooling, CI, or dependencies

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] Added or updated unit/integration tests
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] Changes preserve read-only scope (zero private key handling) and `BigInt` precision for lamports/tokens
- [ ] Updated relevant docs (`README.md`, `docs/API.md`, `docs/RUNBOOK.md`) if user-facing behavior changed
